description: This file contains the source code for the 'Manufacturer' controller class within the OpenCart e-commerce platform. The class manages the display of manufacturer-related pages, including listing manufacturers and showing details for a specific manufacturer, with support for sorting, pagination, and filtering.

classes.name: Manufacturer
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling manufacturer listing and detail pages within the OpenCart catalog module. Extends the base engine Controller class.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles displaying the list of manufacturers, including breadcrumbs, sorting, filtering, pagination, and rendering the manufacturer list view.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Displays detailed information for a specific manufacturer, including associated products, breadcrumbs, sorting options, and pagination.
